Age.rules: Convert textual numbers (e.g., 'thirty') to integers; if unconvertible or missing, represent as missing

Salary.rules: Convert numeric strings and spelled-out numbers (e.g., 'SIXTY THOUSAND') to integer values; treat 'NAN' and similar as missing

Gender.rules: Standardize case to title case; map any invalid or missing to 'Other'

Department.rules: Standardize case to title case; preserve original values if not in list

Position.rules: Preserve original values; correct obvious typos if identifiable (e.g., 'Mr.' to 'Manager' if contextually clear), else keep as is

Joining Date.rules: Parse various date formats (e.g., '05-Apr-18', '2019.12.01', '2/20/2020') to ISO 8601 date format; if unparseable or missing, represent as missing

Performance Score.rules: Standardize to uppercase; treat unrecognized or missing as missing

Employee Statement.rules: Preserve original text; trim leading/trailing whitespace

Status columns (Age_status, Salary_statu.rules: Preserve as integer; treat missing or non-integer as missing

Validated columns (Salary_validated, Gen.rules: Preserve as integer; treat missing or non-integer as missing

numeric_fields.Age: Convert textual numbers to integers (e.g., 'thirty' to 30); if conversion fails or missing, use missing value policy
numeric_fields.Salary: Convert spelled-out numbers (e.g., 'SIXTY THOUSAND') to integer (60000); parse numeric strings; treat 'NAN' and similar as missing

categorical_fields.Gender: Normalize to title case; map invalid or missing to 'Other'
categorical_fields.Department: Normalize to title case; preserve unknown values
categorical_fields.Performance Score: Uppercase; allow only specified values; else missing

date_fields.Joining Date: Parse multiple date formats to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD); if unparseable or missing, use missing value policy
